info.title: 212Learning API
info.description:
REST API for the 212Learning e-learning platform.

**Security Features:**
- Draft courses are protected - only accessible to admins and course instructors
- Course meetings require enrollment (PAID status) or instructor/admin access
- Registration forces student role - role escalation prevented
- Soft-deleted users cannot authenticate
- Pagination supports `limit=-1` and `limit=0` for full-fetch

**All responses follow a consistent envelope:**

```json
// Success
{ "success": true, "data": {}, "meta": {} }

// Error
{ "success": false, "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }
```

**Authentication:** Use the `POST /auth/login` endpoint to get a JWT token, then click the **Authorize** button above and enter: `Bearer <your_token>`

**Password Management:**
- `POST /auth/forgot-password` — public, sends a 5-min reset link by email
- `POST /auth/reset-password/:token` — public, sets new password using the emailed link token
- `PATCH /users/me/password` — logged-in user changes their own password (requires current password)
- `POST /admin/users/:userId/reset-password` — admin triggers sending a 5-min reset link email to any user

bearerAuth.description: Paste your JWT token from POST /auth/login here.

RegisterInput.description: Public registration. `role` = student|instructor|employee (admin is never allowed). Learners (student/employee) send `studentProfile`; instructors send `instructorProfile`. Required profile fields depend on `situation`. `group` is ignored — it is always null at registration and assigned later by an admin/instructor.

password.description: Min 8 chars with letters and numbers.

StudentProfileInput.description: Learner profile. Required fields by situation — student: school, fieldOfStudy, educationLevel, currentLevel, academicYearStart, academicYearEnd; employee: companyName, department, position, sector, experienceYears; student_employee: both; self_directed: interests, learningObjective, currentLevel.

learningObjective.example: Apprendre React et devenir développeur frontend.

InstructorProfileInput.description: Instructor profile. Common required: expertiseDomain, specialization, experienceYears, teachingMode, teachingDomains. employed also requires organization, position, sector; freelance and unemployed require no company.

AuthResponse.description: Returned on successful login or register

token.description: JWT — attach as `Bearer <token>` in subsequent requests

ForgotPasswordInput.description: Step 1 of the forgot-password flow — request a reset link by email

ResetPasswordInput.description: Step 2 of the forgot-password flow — submit a new password using the token from the email link

ChangePasswordInput.description: Logged-in user changes their own password — current password required

AdminResetPasswordInput.description: Admin forcefully resets a user password — no current password required

User.description: Full user object returned by the API

PortfolioCredentials.description: Certifications or diplomas. issuer/institution + optional Cloudinary file.

UpdateUserInput.description: Allowed fields for PATCH /users/me (incl. portfolio: skills, languages, certifications, diplomas, socialLinks — learners & instructors)

get.summary: List all quizzes for a course — grouped by section and lesson
get.description:
Returns a flat list of all quizzes in a course, each enriched with:
- `questionCount` — how many questions the quiz has
- `lessonTitle`, `sectionTitle` — for navigation context
- `lastAttempt` — the requesting student's most recent attempt score (if any)

Used by the **Quiz Player** page (`/learn/:courseId/quiz/:quizId`).

post.summary: Log or update a student's progress on a lesson (student only)
post.description:
Upserts the `LessonProgress` record for the authenticated student.
Sends periodic updates from the **Classroom Player** (`/learn/:courseId/lesson/:lessonId`).
Call this whenever the student pauses, seeks, or completes a video lesson.

completed.description: Mark the lesson as fully completed

videoPosition.description: Current video playback position in seconds

timeSpent.description: Cumulative seconds spent watching this lesson

get.summary: Get a student's gamification achievements — badges, certificates & stats
get.description:
Returns the full achievement panel for the **Student Dashboard** (`/student/dashboard`).
Includes:
- **stats** — completion rate, total enrollments, time spent, badges & certificates earned
- **badges** — list of earned badge definitions with metadata
- **certificates** — list of completed course certificates
- **quizAttempts** — top 10 quiz attempt scores

Only the owner (student themselves) or an Admin can access another user's achievements.

403.description: Forbidden — can only view your own achievements

post.summary: Request a password reset link by email
post.description:
Sends a **5-minute** password reset link to the user's email address.
Always returns `200` even if the email is not found — this prevents
email enumeration attacks (nobody can tell if an account exists or not).

200.description: Reset link sent (or silently ignored if email not found)

post.summary: Reset password using the token received by email
post.description:
Validates the JWT token from the reset email link and sets a new password.
The token is **valid for 5 minutes** and becomes **invalid after first use**
(because the signing secret includes the old password hash).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: JWT reset token extracted from the email link URL

200.description: Password reset successfully — user can now log in

400.description: Token is invalid, tampered, or expired

post.summary: Confirm a learner's email address from the verification link
Restore a soft-deleted account using an OTP received by email
post.description:
After a deleted-account login attempt, a 6-digit OTP is emailed to the user.
Submit `email` + `otp` here to restore the account and receive a login token.
OTP is valid for **15 minutes** and single-use.

200.description: Account restored — returns JWT token + user object

post.summary: Send password reset email link to a user (admin trigger)
post.description:
Admin triggers sending a **5-minute password reset link** to the user's registered email address.
The admin does NOT type the password manually — the user receives an email to set their password safely.
This action is **logged in the audit trail** (`ADMIN_SEND_RESET_EMAIL`).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: UUID of the user to receive the password reset email

200.description: Reset email sent successfully (valid for 5 minutes)
